svg.text: 30 products, 5 views (C1 to C5), 150K+ images, masks on NG samples
C2 to C5 are future work
8 defect types: pit, deformation, abrasion, scratch, damage, missing parts, foreign objects, contamination
NG + mask visible at C1 → anomaly
NG, defect not visible at C1 → relabelled normal
labels are counted by the true verdict, never by the OK/NG folder name
output: one C1 image per sample, with its true verdict and defect type
Prompt payload for one anomalous sample
one call per batch of 5 to 10 samples, the privileged inputs are discarded afterwards
A normal sample is shown one image only.
No mask, no reference, no hint. The two classes are therefore not
generated under identical evidence, see the datasheet caveat (App. I).
all of this is thrown away after the call, one image and one trace survive into the corpus
Section 1 of the AnomalyThink construction: what is read from Real-IAD, and what the teacher sees when it writes a trace.
